_about: Requirements-reader golden set (Yong, 2026-11-17 prompt review). Each posting with the requirements a careful reader takes from it, so the reader's recall is measured before and after any prompt or model change. Postings r1-r4 follow real public postings (source); r5 is a composite for the prompt's edge cases. expect alternatives are split by |; a read entry matches when it contains the expected words. Run live on the server with TC_EVAL_REQ=1 (see apps/worker/src/evalF9.ts), or locally with TC_EVAL_LIVE=1 and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

postings.source: Modelled on Greenhouse, Director, People Systems and Operations (job-boards.greenhouse.io/greenhouse/jobs/8141795), read 2026-11-18
postings.title: Director, People Systems and Operations
postings.text:
About the role
Greenhouse is hiring a Director, People Systems and Operations to lead People Operations and People Systems. You will report to the Chief People Officer and sit on the People Leadership Team.

What you'll do
- Set the strategy and roadmap for our HR technology stack, including vendor management.
- Own the HRIS as the source of truth for employee data.
- Improve key employee moments, from offer to offboarding.
- Build people analytics and self-service tools.
- Own People compliance, including immigration, leaves and audits.
- Lead AI-forward change across People operations, piloting new tools in contained ways.

What you'll bring
- 8+ years of progressive People Operations experience, including 3+ years leading People Operations, HRIS and/or People Systems teams at the manager or director level
- Deep hands-on experience administering global HRIS platforms such as Workday, Rippling or HiBob
- A track record of scaling People processes with measurable results
- Experience with payroll and benefits integrations, cross-border data and workforce privacy; global experience is a plus
- Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI and automation in People operations
- Strong project management and change leadership skills
- Analytical skills, with experience in HR reporting and dashboards
- Experience leading diverse, high-performing teams

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

We know candidates often don't apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway.

expect.authorisation: authorized to work in the United States

postings.title: Director of Operations
postings.text:
Outer Labs builds software for architecture and construction. Our Director of Operations reports directly to the CEO and keeps the business running smoothly.

Responsibilities
- Run bi-annual strategic planning and periodic leadership check-ins.
- Analyze company performance and report it to executives.
- Oversee regulatory and vendor compliance.
- Work with accounting on invoices, payroll approval and vendor reimbursement.
- Set and adjust department budgets.
- Review and approve business contracts before signature.
- Run procurement and administration of business systems and tools.

Qualifications
- MBA preferred
- 5+ years of experience in a similar role
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills
- Ability to build consensus with data-driven arguments
- A bias for action and proactive problem solving

Compensation: $160,000 - $210,000 base, plus bonus and equity.

postings.source: Modelled on Director of Operations, San Francisco (climatebase.org/job/45903898/director-of-operations), read 2026-11-18
postings.title: Director of Operations
postings.text:
The role
We are looking for a Director of Operations to oversee day-to-day operations so the company runs efficiently, set performance goals and long-term operating plans, and work across departments.

What you'll do
- Build day-to-day operating systems and visibility into key initiatives.
- Monitor key operating metrics.
- Plan and forecast budgets and cost of sales.
- Drive company-wide growth and cost-saving process changes.
- Set and enforce operating policies and legal compliance.

Requirements
- 8+ years of related experience
- Broad knowledge of operational functions, including finance, customer service and people management
- Proven success planning efficient operations
- Experience at an early-stage startup, or a realistic understanding of what that means

Preferred
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business Administration or a related field
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Experience developing budgets and business plans
- Organization and attention to detail
- Negotiation skills
- Analytical, decision-making and problem-solving skills
- Working knowledge of data analysis and business management software

A passion for fighting climate change is a plus.

postings.source: Composite health-system posting written for the edge cases in the reader prompt (a range of years, a combined line, a responsibility that names a tool, 'or equivalent experience', a sponsorship line)
postings.title: Vice President, Revenue Cycle Operations
postings.text:
About the role
Our health system is hiring a Vice President, Revenue Cycle Operations to lead patient access, billing and collections across 9 hospitals.

What you'll do
- Lead a team of 40 managers and analysts.
- You will use Workday Financials to report results to the CFO each month.
- Build the revenue cycle roadmap with clinical and finance leaders.

Required qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience
- 7-10 years of revenue cycle leadership in a hospital or health system
- Hands-on experience with Epic Resolute
- Strong SQL and Python skills for operational analysis
- 5 years of experience building Tableau dashboards
- CRCR or CHFP certification

Preferred qualifications
- A master's degree (MHA or MBA) is a plus
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
- Experience with Power BI

Eligibility
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
